prompts.prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop web app UI mockup for Aftertaste, a Russian personal cultural diary, edge to edge landscape 1440 × 1000, no device, browser frame or surroundings. It is a real B2C screen for browsing saved books, films, series, theatre, music and exhibitions, not a landing page. Adult, luxurious retro character inspired by vinyl record sleeves and the precision of classic film cameras. The user explicitly chose a light gallery combined with a deep cool burgundy header, charcoal ink, restrained silver-grey details and clear near-white surfaces. No olive, khaki, yellow, cartoon illustration, fake distressed paper, giant decorative vinyl, photographic camera hero, dashboard statistics or CRM/table layout. Keep a tiny vinyl circle beside the lowercase wordmark “aftertaste”. Type should evoke Prata for a modest headline and entry names, Onest for interface labels, fully readable Cyrillic. Standard web search, category buttons, date/year filters and one “Добавить запись” action. Real labels: “Сколько по десятибалльной?”, “Все”, “Книги”, “Фильмы”, “Сериалы”, “Спектакли”, “Музыкальные альбомы”, “Выставки и музеи”, “Поиск по названию”, “Год”. Show six demonstration entries under “Сентябрь 2026”: “Нормальные люди” Книга 9/10, “Прошлые жизни” Фильм 8/10, “Вишнёвый сад” Спектакль 9/10, “Медведь” Сериал 8/10, “In Rainbows” Radiohead 9/10, “ГЭС-2” Выставка 8/10. Each card has one sophisticated photographic main image, name, category and wine-coloured score; use plausible cinematic/stage, book and vinyl imagery, not toy category objects. Full review and other photos belong in the detail view. Small footer “Демонстрационные записи”. Composition A — gallery-led. A slim deep burgundy brand header above a light workspace. Modest title and add action, category filters, then a separate search/date row. Three columns of visually prominent 3:2 photographs, titles and scores set beneath directly on the light ground, with precisely aligned baselines. Cards read as a personal photographic collection, not repetitive padded panels. Show the second row to prove the system; sophisticated restraint, readable size, no ornamental badges.
